speaker: john_heminges
text: The third time this week we are on at two. Same play. I am not making a new matter of a thing we have done.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Then I will be no newer than I was on Thursday. No added line. Do not offer me one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not offering you one. I am on. The morning is not in it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Good. Play, and come off. The reckoning is after, and it will be short.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Short is a promise I mean to hear you keep.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then hear it kept. God give you the house.

speaker: john_heminges
text: And you. Off when it is done, and not before.
